_what: Aggregate snapshot of Mkan's OWN live Port Sudan inventory, grouped by coordinate. Read-only; nothing was written to the database.
_why_snapshot: The zone generator must be deterministic and runnable without database credentials, so the live query result is checked in rather than re-run. Re-take it with the query below when inventory changes.
_privacy: Counts of PUBLISHED listings per coordinate only. No guest, booking, host or contact data is included.
_query: SELECT l.latitude, l.longitude, l.address, COUNT(*) listings, SUM(CASE WHEN li."isPublished" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) published FROM "Location" l JOIN "Listing" li ON li."locationId" = l.id WHERE l.city = 'Port Sudan' GROUP BY 1,2,3

_data_quality_warnings.detail: 6 listings sit at exactly 19.6158, 37.2164 — which is the Port Sudan centroid declared in scripts/crm/sudan-places.ts (PORT_SUDAN lat/lng). These are not locations, they are the city fallback written when no geocode was captured. Assigning them by proximity would invent a 6-listing downtown cluster that does not exist.
_data_quality_warnings.handling: Forced to zone 'unknown'. The generator asserts that no input coordinate equals the centroid exactly.

_data_quality_warnings.detail: An Mkan listing titled 'Mirak Suites' sits at 19.6014, 37.20647, while the discovered business 'Mirak Furnished Suites' sits at 19.622745, 37.221092 (directory + OSM agree). Same brand, 2.6 km apart.
_data_quality_warnings.handling: Recorded as a data-quality row and left unreconciled. Either the listing is mis-geocoded or it is a second branch; nothing public settles it.

_data_quality_warnings.issue: ADDRESS TEXT IS RICHER HERE THAN IN KHARTOUM
_data_quality_warnings.detail: Four Port Sudan clusters carry a real sub-city address (حي دقنة، وسط المدينة، بالقرب من أبدوت مول), unlike Khartoum where all 95 rows share one address string. So for Port Sudan the address IS usable as a secondary assignment signal — but only for those four.

demand.listing_events_note: The ListingEvent table EXISTS but holds 0 rows — instrumentation has landed and no events have flowed yet. This is 'uninstrumented', NOT 'no interest'.
demand.bookings_all_cities_note: All 35 bookings are Khartoum, all created on a single day (2026-07-06), across 3 listings, with 35 matching reviews. This is seed data and must never be read as transactions.
demand.consequence: Every demand metric in zone-density.json is null and every zone classifies as INSUFFICIENT_DATA on the demand axis. The acquisition score therefore carries a demand weight of 0, documented in zone-methodology.md.
